2170. Machine Running Time

60

Medium

Problem Statement
Read the running time of a machine in seconds. Print it as hours, minutes and seconds.
Description
A machine's meter shows its running time only in seconds. Read this time and convert it into hours, minutes and seconds. 1 hour = 3600 seconds and 1 minute = 60 seconds. For example, 3725 seconds is 1 hour, 2 minutes and 5 seconds.
input_spec: A single integer, the total running time in seconds. (0 <= seconds <= 86399)
output_spec: Print the hours on the first line, the minutes on the second line, and the seconds on the third line. Print only the numbers.
